description_en: Disables a specified notification policy. After the policy is disabled, notifications are paused but all configurations are retained. The policy can be re-enabled
description_zh: 停用指定通知策略。停用后策略暂停发送通知，但保留全部配置，可再次启用
name: DisableNotifyPolicy

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Used to isolate notification policy resources across different business spaces
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间 ID，用于隔离不同业务空间的通知策略资源
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the notification policy, returned by the create operation
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略的唯一标识，由创建接口返回
parameters.name: uuid
